rules: GitRegistry project/publicDomain/publicApi and mapping domain data remain declaration authorities; current server/vhost observation remains evidence of what is actually served
protectedDomains remains a safety list and is never treated as the domain model
FRONTEND and API roles are derived only from explicit project or component-role declarations; roleless historical mappings never invent a stronger role
a roleless mapping on the same domain as an explicit project declaration merges as evidence into that declared role
multiple distinct current domains for the same declared role fail closed as AMBIGUOUS
historicalVhosts are excluded from the active surface and reported explicitly; they are never promoted automatically
NONE is returned only when current project declarations explicitly contain no publicDomain/publicApi, current-server mappings declare no domain and current observation proves an empty active surface
missing or unavailable observation is UNVERIFIED and never NONE
stale domain evidence is UNVERIFIED with STALE freshness
current observed domains not declared by the resolved project fail closed as UNVERIFIED
declared active domains not present in current observation fail closed as UNVERIFIED
domain observation is bound to the resolved server
resolver is READ_ONLY and performs no vhost mutation, authorization inference, persistence or probing side effect

behavior: GW-09 resolves typed FRONTEND/API/OTHER domain surface from current project/server/registry/observation evidence
domainless projects can resolve to proven NONE without conflating missing observation with no domain
historical vhosts are excluded and reported explicitly
undeclared observed domains and unobserved declared domains remain fail-closed
multiple domains for the same role are AMBIGUOUS rather than silently prioritized
legacy V2 mappings that omit optional componentRole remain compatible without inventing an extra role
GW-09 wrapper binds canonical contract metadata and remains READ_ONLY
